scripts.//postinstall: ⚠️ Without this, a clean `npm install` leaves the Prisma client ungenerated — and then `tsc` reports ~350 errors in 77 files about code that is entirely correct, because every query result types as `any`. Anybody opening this repository for the first time, on any machine, sees that and concludes the project is broken. It also means `deploy/new-tenant.sh` depended on remembering to run `prisma generate` by hand.
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
